summary: A rejected refinement result and an accepted no_ship review open the same settling review obligation. Shared oracle context retains canonical finding IDs, bindings, and receipt references without productive acceptance or a new correction-count family. Existing correction records use the exact derived open set; outside-scope P0 follow-ups stay visible without becoming repair obligations. Delivery remains held until a fresh accepted ship or legacy absent verdict settles the debt. Only the newest completed review can bind; recorded freshness and recovery remain unchanged.
title: An accepted no-ship review opens the settling review obligation
